3. Place a dial gauge approximately 5 mm (0.2 inch) from the 
outer circumference of the brake disc, and measure the run-
out of the disc.
Limit: 0.06 mm (0.002 inch)
4. If the run-out of the brake disc is limit value or more, turn 
rotor with an on-car type brake lathe ("Accuturn-8750" or 
equivalent). If it still exceeds the limit, inspect hub end play.
Limit: 0.05 mm (0.002 inch)
5. If the play exceeds the limit, check the hub. If the play does 
not exceed the limit, replace the brake disc.
REAR BRAKE DISC RUN-OUT CHECK AND 
CORRECTION
M1351009400125
1. Remove the caliper support; then raise the caliper assembly 
upward and secure it with a wire.
2. Check the disc surface for grooves, cracks and rust. Clean 
the disc thoroughly and remove all rust.
3. Place a dial gauge approximately 5 mm (0.2 inch) from the 
outer circumference of the brake disc, and measure the run-
out of the disc.
Limit: 0.08 mm (0.003 inch)
4. If the run-out of the brake disc is the limit value or more, 
change the phase of the disc and hub, and then measure 
the run-out again.
(1) Before removing the brake disc, place a mating mark on 
both the wheel stud and disc with chalk where the run-out 
is greatest.
